title: Specify the shared source_id v1 capture and verification contract
outcome: A docs-only candidate at docs/features/source-identity.md defining one capture_source/verify_source contract, byte-compatible content-v1 without gitlinks, pinned submodule eligibility and refusals, and phased consumer migration, sent to TermAl::Fable2, Engram::Fable and Kimi::Consultant for wording review.
acceptance: The document defines one capture_source/verify_source contract and ordered consumers: test credit now, TermAl review_freeze/review_identity next, Engram Node tooling later.

The document preserves existing content-v1 hash inputs and values for no-gitlink content admitted both before and after the change, allows differing on-disk directory case spelling, and specifies the distinct-tracked-path case/NFC/NFD collision refusal as the only new refusal, without changing terminal-symlink or distinct-name-hard-link treatment. It defines the general git-commit:<full commit id> lane, with the tree recorded separately, and commit-input v1 eligibility for repositories with or without gitlinks: every child is initialized at its recorded pin; Git status is empty in the root and every child, with no exception list; uninitialized, wrong-pin, dirty and nested children are ineligible; the committed lane adds no on-disk case or filesystem collision check. It specifies supported object formats and explicit refusals, Git-ignored output outside the cleanliness judgment, canonical content-v1 ordering, path independence, read-only capture, retained guards and before/after eligibility checks, the adopted different-blob, identical-blob and dirty-child Git observations, and that no source-identity change rewrites, recomputes, relabels, invalidates, deletes or re-runs a stored evaluation, verification or seal.
The document explains migration and authority consequences and is sent to Fable2, Engram::Fable and Kimi::Consultant for wording review; this task changes documentation only.
